not_money_ready_disclaimer: audit3 is an evidence ledger, not a signal service. PROVEN_T2 means the realized closed-pick ledger survives the listed gates; it does not guarantee future returns. No position sizing is emitted here.

cost_basis.note: per-strategy measured where available, measured class otherwise

conventions.win_definition: net pnl_pct > 0 after per-class round-trip slippage
conventions.edge_test: net-expectancy bootstrap CI, one-sided; WR is a descriptor only
conventions.p_value: one-sided bootstrap P(net mean <= 0), 2,000 seeded resamples
conventions.p_wr: one-sided exact binomial P(X>=wins) under p=0.5 — reported, never gated
conventions.promotion_rule: PROVEN_T2 = n>=100, net CI lower bound >= max(0.05%/trade, 50% of the cell's mean round-trip cost), stable halves, no symbol > 60%, source share <= 90%, BH q <= 0.1, DSR >= 0.95, selection alpha CI lower bound > 0 (G8)
conventions.selection_alpha_gate: G8: PROVEN_T2 requires direction-adjusted selection alpha (pick net - hold) bootstrap CI lower bound > 0; a beta-only profitable cell is demoted to CANDIDATE and flagged beta_dominant
conventions.cost_stress: net CI lower bound at 2x the class slippage must stay positive to reach PROVEN_T2 or CANDIDATE (G9); otherwise the cell demotes one tier
conventions.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across tested cells; Bonferroni alpha/m = 0.000746
conventions.stability: chronological split-half, both halves net mean > 0
conventions.recency_rule: PROVEN_T2 requires the trailing 25% of closes (min 5) to have a non-negative net mean; otherwise the verdict is capped at CANDIDATE
conventions.persistence_rule: a CANDIDATE/PROVEN_T2 verdict must persist across 2 consecutive runs; BH is per-run, so a single cross is not enough
conventions.random_entry_mc: not run here (needs per-symbol price series); see alpha_engine/benchmark_closed_ledger.py for the timing-null companion report.

coverage.statement: audit3 scores 8,781 of 14,874 closed picks (59.0%). The other 6,093 are not in this ledger: the publishing dashboard reports 6,001 integrity-excluded and 9,219 auto-expired rows, and no surface scores any of them. Those cohorts overlap, so they do not sum to the gap — read them as reasons rows are missing, not as a partition. This run scores the canonical resolved view (sha256 83f17206faf6…).

selection_alpha.definition: alpha = pick net return - direction-adjusted buy & hold over the same entry..exit window (M1b)
selection_alpha.why_it_matters: A +40% pick on a symbol that returned +60% is a selection failure; a win-rate or PF table cannot see that.
